::: {.page-intro}
Grouped by the week each dataset was introduced. Use the **raw** link with `pd.read_csv()` — never a relative path, since opening a notebook via the Colab-from-GitHub link only fetches that one file, not the whole repo.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

RAW_BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stevenolanecon/7002LBSAI/main/data/"

data_groups = [
    ("Week 1", [
        ("synthetic_reaction_times.csv", "Placeholder reaction-time data used to build and test slides before the live class dataset exists"),
        ("reaction_times.xlsx", "Generated test dataset — 16 students, 10 trials each — used for demos and dry runs"),
    ]),
    ("Week 4", [
        ("hotels_vienna.csv", "Hotel prices and star ratings for Vienna — Békés & Kézdi's own case study"),
        ("hotels_europe_nov2017_weekday.csv", "European hotel prices, Nov 2017 weekday stays, 46 cities"),
        ("used_cars_chicago.csv", "Toyota Camry listings from Chicago — age, mileage, price"),
    ]),
    ("Week 5", [
        ("wms_management_2006.csv", "World Management Survey, 2006 wave, 13 countries"),
    ]),
    ("Week 6", [
        ("cps_gender_pay_gap.csv", "US Current Population Survey earnings data — gender pay gap case study"),
        ("worldbank_lifeexp_2017.csv", "World Bank life expectancy and GDP data, 2017, with continent groupings"),
    ]),
    ("Week 8", [
        ("share_health.csv", "Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe — smoking and health outcomes"),
        ("bike_sharing_day.csv", "UCI daily bike-share rental counts"),
        ("wms_management_2010_export.csv", "World Management Survey, 2010 wave, includes export share"),
    ]),
    ("Week 9", [
        ("wfh_person.csv", "Bloom et al.'s Working from Home field experiment (Ctrip RCT)"),
        ("food_health.csv", "NHANES food intake and blood pressure data"),
        ("ab_test_social_media.csv", "Social media ad A/B test click-through data"),
    ]),
    ("Week 10", [
        ("cps_earnings_2014.csv", "Full 2014 CPS earnings sample — 149,316 individuals"),
        ("airbnb_hackney.csv", "Airbnb listings in the London borough of Hackney"),
        ("airbnb_london.csv", "Airbnb listings across all of London, 33 boroughs"),
    ]),
    ("Week 11", [
        ("stocks_monthly.csv", "Monthly stock prices (MSFT, AAPL) and S&P 500, with risk-free rate"),
        ("arizona_electricity.csv", "Arizona electricity demand and temperature data"),
        ("swim_tickets.csv", "Daily swimming-pool ticket sales — seasonality case study"),
        ("case_shiller_la.csv", "Case-Shiller Los Angeles house price index"),
    ]),
]

for week, items in data_groups:
    print(f'<div class="data-group"><h3>{week}</h3><table class="data-table"><tbody>')
    for name, desc in items:
        # Single line — Pandoc's raw-HTML-block passthrough is unreliable
        # across multi-line nested tags under `output: asis`.
        print(f'<tr><td class="fname">{name}</td><td class="fdesc">{desc}</td>'
              f'<td class="flink"><a href="{RAW_BASE}{name}">raw ↗</a></td></tr>')
    print("</tbody></table></div>")
```
